dsh-scrapling

Scrapling web scraping for dsh: JavaScript rendering, structured extraction and a background crawler, behind one resident Python sidecar.

readme.text: **A web-scraping extension for [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): [Scrapling](https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling) as agent tools — JavaScript rendering, CSS/XPath extraction with self-healing selectors, sessions with login state, a background crawler and page Q&A. You supply the interpreter and the browser engine; everything runs in one resident Python process.**

readme.section: What it does
readme.text: dsh ships `web_fetch` and `web_search`. The built-in `web_fetch` is deliberately honest and minimal: a plain HTTP(S) GET with no JavaScript execution and an honest User-Agent. That is a good default — and it means a single-page application yields only its loading shell, and there is no way to ask for "just the product table". Measured on a page whose content exists only after JavaScript runs:

readme.section: What it does
readme.text:
| Pipeline | Text obtained |
|---|---|
| raw HTML to text (no JS) | `SPA Shell / LOADING_PLACEHOLDER` |
| `Fetcher` (curl_cffi, still no JS) | `SPA Shell / LOADING_PLACEHOLDER` |
| browser render (patchright) | full rendered DOM, Markdown table, structured rows |

This package adds what the built-ins structurally cannot do:

readme.section: What it does
readme.text:
- **Browser rendering** — JavaScript execution via patchright.
- **Structured extraction** — CSS/XPath selection returning data, not a wall of Markdown.
- **Self-healing selectors** — Scrapling's `adaptive` mode relocates an element after the site's markup changes; a selector that returns `None` after a class rename returns the relocated element with `adaptive` on.

readme.section: What it does
readme.text: Everything runs against **one long-lived Python process**. That is not an optimisation: Scrapling's session classes keep cookies, the browser engines keep a page pool, and `adaptive` keeps a SQLite fingerprint database — a process per call would throw all of that away. Tools are registered **conditionally**: the plugin probes what the environment can actually do at startup and registers only what will work, so the model never burns a turn on a tool that was guaranteed to fail. Every tool renders its result row through the official tool-call view slot. `scrapling_answer` is the only tool that spends **another model call** — see [The tools](#the-tools).

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-scrapling
```

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-scrapling`. The package is on the public npm registry, so installation needs no credentials and no scoped-registry line.

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
```sh
pip install "scrapling[rag]>=0.5,<0.6"
python -m patchright install chromium
```

readme.section: Install
readme.text:
- **Why `rag` and not `fetchers`:** `rag` is `fetchers` plus `markdownify`, and the default `extractionType` is `markdown` — with plain `fetchers` the first fetch raises `ModuleNotFoundError` at the Markdown conversion.
- **Version range:** developed and verified against Scrapling **0.5**, through interfaces that are not stable API surface (`Selector`, `Spider`, `SessionManager`, and the converter's noise-stripping helpers). The upper bound is pinned below `0.6`; outside the range the guards still run, but the anti-injection cleaning and the crawl path may not behave as documented. In 0.5 the browser backend is patchright only (the old standalone stealth fetch is gone; its anti-detection arguments live on `scrapling_render`), `capture_xhr` became session-level recording (hence `scrapling_session_network`), and `extra_flags` became additive — this package sends none, and WebRTC leak protection is carried by the `blockWebrtc` switch.
- **Without the installer, the browser engine is yours.** The optional CLI can install the verified macOS arm64 set; the plugin itself downloads nothing at load time. Without a browser it simply does not register the browser-dependent tools, so the model

readme.section: Shared version floor
readme.text: If your profile pins `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared` with a pnpm `overrides` entry, that pin must be at least the version this package declares. A lower pin installs a copy without the names the sources use, and the host then reports `N entries did not activate` together with `does not provide an export named ...` at boot - the package installs fine and never loads, and no per-repository CI run can see it.

readme.section: Runtime packs (macOS arm64)
readme.text:
The package ships `bin/dsh-scrapling.mjs`. It installs the ability packs into `dataDir/runtime` (default `~/.dsh-scrapling`) — never into system Python and never into the user's Playwright cache. There is **no `postinstall`**; nothing is downloaded when the plugin loads.

```sh
dsh-scrapling setup --feature core --apply
dsh-scrapling setup --feature browser --apply
dsh-scrapling setup --status
```

readme.section: Runtime packs (macOS arm64)
readme.text:
- `core` installs managed Python 3.14.9, Scrapling 0.5 and its pinned wheels; `browser` adds the full Chromium build (not the headless shell).
- `search`, `media`, `mcp` and `adaptive-redis` all ride on `core`'s venv: `mcp` brings the official `scrapling-mcp` server (the pinned `mcp` package; its tool set is the upstream's, not this plugin's) that `official-mcp` mode needs, and `adaptive-redis` brings the `redis` client behind `adaptiveStorage: redis`. Every pack is installable; the settings card reports each as `ready`, `missing`, `corrupt` or `installing`.
- `--feature` is a dry run by default; `--apply` writes. `--repair` re-installs without touching user data, and `--uninstall <pack> [--purge]` removes runtime files; only `--purge` removes `elements_storage.db` and `downloads/`.
- `--offline <dir>` installs with no network at all: `<dir>` must hold the Python archive named exactly as the manifest URL's last segment (browser and `curl -O` both keep `cpython-3.14.9+…-install_only.tar.gz`, and the percent-encoded spelling is accepted too) plus a `wheels/` directory with one wheel per pinned requirement - `pip download --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes -r py/runtime-requirements

readme.section: What it does not provide
readme.text:
- **It is not a search engine.** Discovery runs in the Python sidecar against one of six backends (`searchBackend`: `auto` / `tavily` / `bing` / `brave` / `serper` / `duckduckgo` / `searxng`); Scrapling's own `google_search` option only sets a referer header. - **The npm tarball bundles no interpreter or browser.** They come from your machine or from the optional CLI installer, which downloads the verified macOS arm64 set into `dataDir/runtime`; missing pieces remove the matching tools instead of being fetched at load time.

readme.section: The tools
readme.text:
- **Quotas.** At most 8 open sessions (3 of them browser sessions, each a real Chromium process), 2 crawls in flight, per-page bodies clipped by `*MaxOutputChars`, 8 MB per protocol frame, 16 queued frames. A ceiling answers with a specific code (`SESSION_LIMIT` / `CRAWL_BUSY` / `BAD_FRAME`) the model can back off from.
- **`scrapling_crawl` returns a job id immediately** — a crawl takes minutes and a tool call has a timeout. Watch it with `job_list`, read it with `job_output`, stop it with `job_kill`; the tool needs a jobs registry that can attach a controller, and a profile without one simply does not register it (single-page fetching is unaffected). The crawl has a wall-clock ceiling (`crawlMaxRuntimeSeconds`) and never leaves the start domain. Politeness defaults follow Scrapling's spider defaults — robots.txt is **not** obeyed, per-domain delay is 0, up to 4 requests run in parallel — and is a deployment decision, not a per-call one (see [Settings](#settings)).
- **`scrapling_answer` fetches the page first, then hands the text plus your question to a model** and returns the conclusion instead of the whole page. It follows the model the current session is already using by defau

readme.section: Render or static
readme.text: `scrapling_render` is much slower and heavier than `scrapling_fetch`, so start static. Two criteria:

readme.section: Render or static
readme.text:
- **If the rendered result is shorter than the static fetch, go back to static.** Plenty of sites ship readable text from the server and then have their own script empty those containers and swap in canvas / Lottie animation — for those pages rendering can only lose content, and no wait setting brings it back. That is site behaviour, not a plugin defect.
- **`waitSelector` waits for an element to appear, not for content to settle.** The element can be removed after it matched, so "the selector matched" does not mean the content is in the result.

readme.section: Render or static
readme.text: One thing that is not a criterion but worth knowing: axis ticks inside SVG **cannot be fetched at all** — the Markdown conversion emits no `<svg>` / `<text>` nodes, so chart numbers are out of reach whichever tool you use. For actual values, go through `scrapling_capture_xhr` to locate the JSON endpoint.

readme.section: Replacing the built-in fetch and search
readme.text: The plugin registers itself as a **fetch provider** and a **search provider** on `ctx.web`, so the built-in `web_fetch` / `web_search` tools actually run on Scrapling instead of dsh's plain-HTTP implementation. The model still calls `web_fetch` / `web_search` — tool names cannot be swapped (same-name registration throws), the provider seam is the supported channel. Both providers are registered by default (`provideWebFetch` / `provideWebSearch`), but that alone displaces nothing:

readme.section: Replacing the built-in fetch and search
Replacing the built-in fetch and search
readme.text:
- **If the sidecar cannot start, the built-in `web_fetch` reports `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`** rather than quietly falling back to plain HTTP.
- **If you later remove the plugin but leave the line in**, the built-in tools report `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING` — go back and remove `fetchProvider` / `searchProvider` too.
- **The fetch provider really applies the output budget**: a body over `fetchMaxOutputChars` is cut to a head/tail window and flagged `truncated`, not passed through with a flag. Failures keep the sidecar code prefix (`URL_BLOCKED`, `SIDECAR_TIMEOUT`, `SIDECAR_UNAVAILABLE`), so a policy refusal is distinguishable from a crash or a timeout.

readme.section: Replacing the built-in fetch and search
readme.text: Search is split in two, because Scrapling is not a search engine: **discovery** runs in the Python sidecar against the backend `searchBackend` names — Tavily, Bing HTML, Brave (API), Serper (API), DuckDuckGo HTML or SearXNG (JSON API); **reading** is this plugin's — the first `searchRenderTopN` results are actually fetched and, with a browser, rendered, so one `web_search` call returns both which pages matter and what they say. `auto` uses Tavily when `tavilyApiKey` is set, SearXNG when `searxngEndpoint` is set, and with neither configured it only goes to a public engine (Bing; DuckDuckGo when that backend is named explicitly) if `searchPublicFallback` is on — otherwise the provider is unavailable and `web_search` reports `SEARCH_BACKEND_MISSING` instead of querying anyone. Only Tavily and Bing have been exercised against the real endpoints here; Brave, Serper, DuckDuckGo and SearXNG are implemented to their documented request/response shapes and verified against local stubs, with real keys and real instances still unverified. Every returned URL goes through the same gate as a fetch; a page that fails to read is skipped alone, because search results routinely contain dead links.

readme.section: Replacing the built-in fetch and search
readme.text: One consequence to know: `dsh-web`'s fetch body is a **closed** union of `html | text` with no `markdown` kind, and adding one is a cross-package change a plugin cannot make. The fetch provider therefore reports Scrapling's Markdown as `text`, which the built-in renderer displays normally. Use `scrapling_fetch` directly when you need `html` or a CSS selector.

readme.section: MCP mode
readme.text: `integrationMode` selects one of three mutually exclusive tool surfaces. It is deployment configuration (the `config:` block of `cordis.patch.yml`), it is read once when the plugin is assembled, and changing it requires a restart.

readme.section: MCP mode
readme.text:
| Mode | What it registers |
|---|---|
| `native` (default) | the `scrapling_*` tools listed above |
| `mcp` | no native tools; the plugin serves the same tool table over MCP |
| `official-mcp` | no native tools and no server from this plugin; `setup` only generates the `dsh-mcp-client` entry for the official `scrapling-mcp`, which runs in its own process, with its own sessions, and **without this plugin's URL guard** |

readme.section: MCP mode
readme.text: In `mcp` mode the server runs inside the plugin's own host process and calls the same sidecar, so the URL guard, sessions, jobs and adaptive storage are the same ones the native tools use — there is no second implementation to drift.

readme.section: MCP mode
readme.text:
- **Endpoint** `http://127.0.0.1:<mcpPort>/mcp` (`mcpPort`, default `39217`). Only loopback is bound; a request whose declared body exceeds 1 MiB is refused with `413`, and any other path gets `404`. The server is stateless: each request gets its own protocol instance, so nothing survives across them.
- **Auth** off by default. Set the environment variable `DSH_SCRAPLING_MCP_TOKEN` and every request must then carry `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. The token is only ever read from the environment, never from the profile, so it does not land in a config file.
- **Tools** are the same `ToolDefinition` objects native registers: same JSON Schema, same argument validation, same renderers. `scrapling_answer` is not served — it routes through the model of the hosting session, which an external client does not have. `search` exists only on this surface, because an MCP client has no `ctx.web` seam. The gates are identical: with `allowBrowserActions=false` there is no `session_act`, with `allowFileDownloads=false` there is no `download`, and `search` is absent when no search backend is available.

readme.section: MCP mode
readme.text:
Connecting dsh needs `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, which this plugin deliberately does not depend on. Pin the build that matches the current host — npm `latest` is older than the host's own line and the host rejects the mismatch:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.2-rc.1

readme.section: host on the 0.2.1-rc.5 line: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.5
readme.text:
```

Then add one entry to that profile's `cordis.patch.yml` — this is exactly what `dsh-scrapling setup --mode mcp` prints, so you can also let the CLI write it (drop `headers` when no token is configured):

readme.section: host on the 0.2.1-rc.5 line: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.5
readme.text:
```yaml
- insert:
    - id: scrapling-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: scrapling
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:39217/mcp
        failOnStartupError: false
        # only with DSH_SCRAPLING_MCP_TOKEN set:
        # headers:
        #   Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.DSH_SCRAPLING_MCP_TOKEN}`'
```

`mcpPort` and that URL have to say the same thing; after changing the port, re-apply the entry.

readme.section: host on the 0.2.1-rc.5 line: @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.5
readme.text: `failOnStartupError` is `false` here on purpose: the port only starts listening once the plugin has finished handshaking with the Python sidecar, and the client throws its fiber on the **first** failed connect (`Version negotiation probe failed: connect ECONNREFUSED` → the host reports `1 entry did not activate`). Its own reconnect is on by default (500ms backoff, 10 attempts), so a first-attempt refusal is meant to be absorbed - setting this to `true` would let fiber start order decide whether the mode works. The official `stdio` entry keeps `true`: there the client spawns the server itself, so a failed connect is a real failure and should be loud.

readme.section: `setup --mode` and `doctor`
readme.text: `setup --mode` writes that entry text; it never edits a profile. Without `--apply` it is a dry run, and with `--apply` it drops the text in `<dataDir>/mcp/<mode>.patch.yml` and prints the path - applying it to `cordis.patch.yml` stays your action, because the host offers no safe append API for that file (`dsh --dump-config` rewrites the profile's root config).

readme.section: `setup --mode` and `doctor`
readme.text:
```sh
dsh-scrapling setup --mode mcp --port 45991 --with-auth --apply
dsh-scrapling setup --mode native --apply     # a file that deliberately contains no entry
dsh-scrapling doctor --mode mcp --profile <profileDir>
```

readme.section: `setup --mode` and `doctor`
readme.text: `doctor` reads what the profile actually says - `cordis.patch.yml` plus that profile's `package.json` - and prints one line per problem: two entries under `serverName: scrapling`, this plugin's entry next to an official `stdio` one, entries that do not match the mode, an entry whose port disagrees with `--port`, a profile without `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` or with it pinned to something other than `0.2.2-rc.1` / `0.2.2-alpha.3` / `0.2.1-rc.5` / `next`, and an official entry while `officialMcpEnabled` is off. Exit `0` is "consistent", `1` names at least one problem, `2` is a bad argument. `integrationMode` itself is a plugin setting the CLI cannot read, so `--mode` is the claim being checked and has to match the deployment.

readme.section: `setup --mode` and `doctor`
readme.text: `official-mcp` asks for two separate statements before it produces anything: `officialMcpEnabled: true` in the profile and `--accept-risk` on the command line; missing either one prints `OFFICIAL_MCP_DISABLED` / `RISK_NOT_ACCEPTED` and writes nothing. The entry it generates starts `<dataDir>/runtime/venv/bin/scrapling-mcp`, so run `setup --feature mcp --apply` first - see [Runtime packs](#runtime-packs-macos-arm64). When that binary is missing, `setup` prints a line saying so.

readme.section: Proxies
readme.text:
Where a fetch goes out, resolved in this order — **first hit wins**:

1. `proxyBypass` or the environment's `NO_PROXY` matches this host -> direct.
2. `proxyUrl` on the settings card is non-empty -> use it.
3. `http_proxy` / `https_proxy` / `all_proxy` in the environment (upper case works too) -> use the matching slot.
4. The operating system's proxy settings (`scutil --proxy` on macOS, Internet Settings on Windows) -> use them.
5. Neither -> direct.

readme.section: Proxies
readme.text: What that looks like in practice — **with or without a proxy, the tools just work, with no setting to fill in**:

readme.section: Proxies
readme.text:
| Your setup | Static fetching | Render / XHR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| No proxy | direct | direct |
| TUN mode (system-wide) | direct, forwarded by the TUN | same |
| `HTTPS_PROXY` exported in the shell | follows it automatically | follows it automatically |
| macOS / Windows "system proxy" switch | **follows it automatically** | follows it automatically |
| Intranet targets / internal Git | exclude with `proxyBypass` | exclude with `proxyBypass` |
| PAC (auto-config script) | not followed; stderr says to set `proxyUrl` | followed natively by the browser |

readme.section: Proxies
readme.text:
- **The resolved proxy is handed to the browser engine explicitly.** Chromium does not read `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY`, so a proxy that is only exported in a shell would cover static fetches but not the browser — this package closes that gap by passing the resolved proxy on every browser fetch. A **browser session** still picks its proxy once, at `scrapling_session_open`: switching it means a new browser context, which throws away the session's cookies and login state — precisely the reason a session exists. Static sessions decide per request.
- **PAC is the one shape that needs a hand-filled `proxyUrl`.** Evaluating a PAC script means downloading it and running JavaScript, and the dialects differ per platform, so this package does not guess; static fetching says so on stderr, and the browser follows PAC natively through its own system settings.
- **A proxy and synthetic DNS are two different problems.** A fake-IP proxy resolves **every** domain into `198.18.0.0/15` (TUN clients often `100.64.0.0/10`); neither is public unicast, so the gate would reject every URL — turning a proxy on would stop the plugin from working. The gate detects that class of resolver on its own (three contr

readme.section: Security
readme.text: - **SSRF.** Scrapling itself has no SSRF protection. This package adds a URL policy on the host side — scheme allowlist, rejection of URLs with embedded credentials, length cap, rejection of an authority containing a backslash or control characters, DNS resolution with a whole-answer-set public-address check, IPv4-mapped and NAT64 addresses reclassified by their embedded IPv4 — and enforces the scheme, credential and address rules again on the Python side (the length cap stays with the host policy, because it is a deployment setting). Outbound paths accept only `http`/`https` and reject embedded credentials; `ws`/`wss` are judged by address alone in the WebSocket-handshake check. **What is judged is what gets sent**: the gate decides on the WHATWG-normalised form and the sidecar forwards that same string, otherwise "judged A, connected to B" would be a bypass in its own right. The host-side policy is enforced in one place (`SidecarClient.call`), and that one place screens every URL the model hands over **as something to fetch** — `url`, plus crawl's `sitemapUrl` and `feedUrl` — with one deliberate exclusion: the three offline parsers (`scrapling_extract`, `scrapling_locate`, `scrap

readme.section: Known boundaries
readme.text:
- **Rendering can only lose content on pages that ship readable text and then swap it out.** Sites that serve text for search engines and no-JS users, then empty those containers into canvas / Lottie animation, come back emptier after rendering — see [Render or static](#render-or-static).
- **Axis ticks inside SVG are unreachable in every tool**: the Markdown conversion emits no `<svg>` / `<text>` nodes. For chart values, locate the JSON endpoint with `scrapling_capture_xhr`.
- **A browser session's proxy is fixed at `session_open`**, and `proxyBypass` does not apply per URL inside it (a context switch would discard the cookies and login state that are the point of a session). Static sessions decide per request.
- **`headers` and `retries` on `scrapling_session_fetch` belong to static sessions.** Upstream silently drops both for browser sessions, so this package refuses them with `BAD_ARGS` naming the knob to use instead — a silent no-op is the failure mode it exists to eliminate.
- **Browser identity knobs only live on the tools that can apply them.** `useragent` / `locale` / `timezoneId` / `headless` are model-visible on the one-shot browser tools and on `scrapling_session_open`

readme.section: 它做什么
readme.text:
dsh 自带 `web_fetch` 与 `web_search`。内置的 `web_fetch` 刻意做「诚实且最小」：纯 HTTP(S) GET，不执行 JavaScript，UA 也是诚实的。作为默认档这没问题 —— 代价是**单页应用只会拿到加载中的空壳**，而且没法要求「只给我那个商品表格」。在一个「内容只有 JS 执行后才出现」的页面上实测：

| 管线 | 拿到的文本 |
|---|---|
| 原始 HTML 转文本（无 JS） | `SPA Shell / LOADING_PLACEHOLDER` |
| `Fetcher`（curl_cffi，同样无 JS） | `SPA Shell / LOADING_PLACEHOLDER` |
| 浏览器渲染（patchright） | 完整渲染后的 DOM、Markdown 表格、结构化行 |

本包补的是内置工具结构上做不到的事：

readme.section: 它做什么
readme.text:
- **浏览器渲染** —— 经 patchright 执行 JavaScript。
- **结构化抽取** —— CSS/XPath 选择后返回数据，而不是一大坨 Markdown。
- **选择器自愈** —— Scrapling 的 `adaptive` 模式能在站点改版后重新定位元素；class 改名后原选择器返回 `None`，`adaptive` 打开时能重定位到元素。

一切都在**同一个常驻 Python 进程**里跑。这不是优化选择：Scrapling 的会话类要保留 cookie，浏览器引擎要保留页面池，`adaptive` 要保留 SQLite 指纹库 —— 每次调用起一个进程，这些东西全都会丢。工具是**条件注册**的：插件启动时先探测运行环境真正具备什么，只注册能用的，模型不会浪费一轮去调用一个注定失败的工具。每个工具的结果行都经官方 tool-call 视图槽渲染。`scrapling_answer` 是唯一会**再调一次模型**的工具 —— 见[工具一览](#工具一览)。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @jayyuen66/dsh-scrapling
```

卸载用 `dsh plugin --profile web remove @jayyuen66/dsh-scrapling`。包在公共 npm registry 上，安装不需要凭据，也不需要 scoped-registry 配置行。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
- **需要 Node.js `>= 24.9`。** 本包是 ESM-only，且构建入口（`build-client.ts`、`build-host.ts`、`build-cli.ts`）由 `node` 直接执行，所以下限必须落在 TypeScript 类型剥离默认开启的那一侧（Node 22.18 起）。数字本身取自宿主：`0.2.2` 系列宿主声明 Node `>= 24.9.0`，低于它的宿主根本起不来。 - **需要宿主 `dsh` 处在 `0.2.1-rc.5` 或 `0.2.2-alpha.3` 版本线。** 宿主真正读的是 `engines.dsh`（`^0.2.1-rc.5 || ^0.2.2-alpha.3`），且它**单独决定**；更新版本线的宿主会被拒，需要显式风险授权 `dsh plugin --profile

allow-version @ --dsh-version --accept-risk`。支持窗口是滚动的：本包在发布时把窗口内的每个已发布宿主版本逐版取证，窗口滚动后重新取证，不把这一句里的版本号当长期承诺。 - **需要 Python 3.14+ 且装好 Scrapling** —— 由 `pythonBin` 指定，或按 `lib/runtime.ts` 的固定链找到：`dataDir/runtime` 下的托管 runtime → 仓内 `_env/.venv` → `PATH`。装出去的包里没有 `_env/.venv` 这一档，所以跑过 `setup --feature core --apply` 的机器用的是那支托管解释器，没装过就是你 `PATH` 上的 `python3`（Windows 上是 `python`）；选中哪一支会在装载时写进日志，缺 Scrapling 时报错里带着可直接照抄的安装命令。

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
```sh
pip install "scrapling[rag]>=0.5,<0.6"
python -m patchright install chromium
```

readme.section: 安装
readme.text:
- **为什么是 `rag` 而不是 `fetchers`：** `rag` 就是 `fetchers` 再加上 `markdownify`，而 `extractionType` 默认是 `markdown` —— 装成 `fetchers` 的话，第一次抓取就会在 Markdown 转换处抛 `ModuleNotFoundError`。
- **版本范围：** 本包在 Scrapling **0.5** 上开发与验证，依赖的 `Selector`、`Spider`、`SessionManager` 与转换器的去噪接口都不是稳定 API 面，所以上界钉在 `0.6` 之前；装到范围外时守卫照常运行，但反注入清洗与爬虫链路可能不按预期。0.5 里浏览器后端只剩 patchright（原来独立的 stealth 抓取工具随之删除，反检测参数都在 `scrapling_render` 上）；`capture_xhr` 改成会话级记录（于是有了 `scrapling_session_network`）；`extra_flags` 改为叠加 —— 本包一支都不发，WebRTC 防泄露由 `blockWebrtc` 开关承担。
- **不用安装器时，浏览器引擎由你负责。** 可选 CLI 能装已验证的 macOS arm64 资产；插件自身在装载时不下载任何东西。没有浏览器时它只是不注册依赖浏览器的工具，模型不会浪费一轮去调用它们。
- **`dependencies` 里没有 `@deepseek-ai/*`，这是契约**（`test/publish-manifest.test.ts` 钉住）。消费方 profile 以 `nodeLinker: hoisted` 与 `autoInstallPeers: false` 安装，宿主包一旦进了 `dependencies` 就会物化成真实存在的第二份副本，模块级状态与运行中的宿主裂开 —— 每次原生工具调用都抛错，而构建与测试一路绿。产物按值 import 的宿主包都是 required peer 并保持外部化；门禁会把构建产物真的载入一次、断言没有内联的宿主包正文。
- **产物是 ESM-only 且从不提交** —— `prepack` 重建它，发出去的永远是当前源码产出的那份。

readme.section: shared 的版本下限
readme.text: profile 若用 pnpm `overrides` 钉了 `@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared`，钉的值不得低于本包声明的版本。钉低了会装到一份缺少源码所需名字的产物，宿主启动时报 `N entries did not activate` 与 `does not provide an export named ...` —— 包装得上、永远不装载，任何单仓 CI 都看不见。

readme.section: 运行时能力包（macOS arm64）
readme.text:
包内带 `bin/dsh-scrapling.mjs`。它把能力包装进 `dataDir/runtime`（默认 `~/.dsh-scrapling`）——不写系统 Python，也不写用户的 Playwright 缓存。**没有 `postinstall`**；插件装载时不下载任何东西。

```sh
dsh-scrapling setup --feature core --apply
dsh-scrapling setup --feature browser --apply
dsh-scrapling setup --status
```

readme.section: 运行时能力包（macOS arm64）
readme.text:
- `core` 装托管 Python 3.14.9、Scrapling 0.5 与钉死的 wheel；`browser` 再加完整 Chromium（不是 headless shell）。
- `search`、`media`、`mcp` 与 `adaptive-redis` 都以 `core` 的 venv 为载体：`mcp` 带来 `official-mcp` 模式要的官方 `scrapling-mcp` server（随钉住的 `mcp` 包进来；它的工具集由上游决定，不是本插件的面），`adaptive-redis` 带来 `adaptiveStorage: redis` 背后的 `redis` 客户端。六个包都可安装；设置卡把每个包报成 `ready`、`missing`、`corrupt` 或 `installing`。
- `--feature` 默认 dry-run；`--apply` 才落盘。`--repair` 重装且不碰用户数据；`--uninstall <包> [--purge]` 删运行时文件，只有 `--purge` 才连 `elements_storage.db` 与 `downloads/` 一起删。
- `--offline <目录>` 全程不联网：`<目录>` 里要有 Python 归档（文件名与清单 URL 的最后一段一致，浏览器与 `curl -O` 落盘的 `cpython-3.14.9+…-install_only.tar.gz` 可用，百分号转义那种写法也认），以及一个 `wheels/` 目录（每条钉版一枚 wheel，可用 `pip download --only-binary=:all: --require-hashes -r py/runtime-requirements.txt -d <目录>/wheels` 生成）。Python 归档的哈希校验与联网路径一致，pip 带 `--no-index`；缺归档或缺 wheelhouse 时报 `INSTALL_OFFLINE_ASSETS`，不会悄悄退回联网。
- `setup --status` 打印一份 JSON：`dataDir`、`profile`、`runtime`、`packs` 与 `state`。带 `--profile <目录>` 时读该 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，按本包条目里的 `pythonBin`（宿主真正在用的那个设置）解析解释器；不带时 `profile.path` 为 `null`，输出里有一句说明没读 profile，`runtime` 回落到 CLI 自己的链（托管 runtime → 仓内 `_env/.venv` → PATH `python3`）。要拿 `--status` 和设置卡上

readme.section: 确认它真的在工作
readme.text:
1. **层已挂载。** `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 能看到本包的层行。
   - 这条命令是唯一被认的「它在层栈里」信号，而且它**不是只读的** —— 会把 profile 的根装配文件重写一遍。层行从 stdout 读，stderr **单独**查：未命中的 patch 目标只出现在 stderr，只看退出码证明不了任何事。`# == <层>` 与 `# == <层>, patched by <路径>` 两种形态都要认。
2. **启动日志点名解释器与注册计划。** 有一行打印探测到的能力与注册了几个工具；选中的解释器路径在装载时写进日志。解释器起得来但没装 Scrapling 时，日志点名解释器路径，并附可直接照抄的 pip 命令。
3. **设置卡渲染。** 插件详情页上有 **scrapling** 卡，全部用户可改字段按用途分组；改一个值后保存按钮亮起，写入返回 200。
4. **一次工具往返。** 让模型抓一个重 JS 的页面：结果行经官方 tool-call 视图渲染在会话里。没有浏览器的机器上，render / capture_xhr 不在模型的工具列表里，对应的提示指引也一并消失 —— 那是条件注册在起作用，不是故障。

readme.section: 它不提供什么
readme.text:
- **它不是搜索引擎。** 检索由 Python sidecar 走六条后端之一（`searchBackend`：`auto` / `tavily` / `bing` / `brave` / `serper` / `duckduckgo` / `searxng`）；Scrapling 自己的 `google_search` 选项只是加一个 Google referer 头。每条后端都要自己的配置（`tavilyApiKey`、`braveApiKey`、`serperApiKey`、`searxngEndpoint`）—— 选中却没配的后端报 `SEARCH_AUTH`，不会静默换到别的后端。
- **npm tarball 里没有解释器与浏览器。** 它们来自你的机器，或来自可选的 CLI 安装器 —— 后者把已验证的 macOS arm64 资产装进 `dataDir/runtime`；装载时缺什么就少注册什么，不会临时去下载。
- **它不在宿主侧新增 HTTP 路由。** 设置卡是宿主的配置表单，本包没有自己的 `/api` 面。唯一真会 listen 的是 `integrationMode: mcp` 下那个 MCP server，只绑 `127.0.0.1`（`http://127.0.0.1:<mcpPort>/mcp`）：非 `/mcp` 路径回 404，声明超过 1 MiB 的正文回 413、不带 `Content-Length` 的回 411，Bearer token 只从环境变量 `DSH_SCRAPLING_MCP_TOKEN` 读，没设时启动会往 stderr 打一条「无鉴权、本机任意进程可调」的告知。
- **它不加 dsh 子命令。** 本包自己的 `dsh-scrapling` CLI 管运行时能力包，另外管 MCP 接法的两件事：`setup --mode native|mcp|official-mcp` 生成客户端条目、带 `--apply` 时写到 `<dataDir>/mcp/<模式>.patch.yml`（profile 本体一个字不改），`doctor --mode` 拿那份条目与 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 逐条核对。`setup --status` 给了 `--profile` 时读的也是那份文件里的 `pythonBin`。

readme.section: 在 dsh 里启用
readme.text:
- `dsh.bundle.patch` 指向 `cordis.patch.yml`，里面是**两条条目**：`- name: "@jayyuen66/dsh-plugin-shared"`（卡片组件的供应行，**刻意不写 `id`**，所以插件页不会把它列成可停用组件）与 `- id: scrapling`，`name` 用**裸包名** —— 宿主只扫裸包名条目的 `dsh.client` 声明。
- client 半注册两个面：设置卡（坐在 `plugins.bundle.config` 槽上，键是 bundle 包名 —— 宿主按 `entryKey: pkg.name` 派发，所以卡画在本包的详情页上），以及每个工具在 `tool.call.toolview` 上的一行结果，用官方 tool-call 视图 props 画。
- 设置命名空间就是条目 id `scrapling`；优先级为 设置卡现值 > 注册行 `config:` > schema 默认值。把一项改回默认值保存的是**清除覆盖**而不是写入同一个值，将来默认值变了你这一项也会跟着变。
- 闸门策略与 sidecar 环境在插件 `apply()` 时取一次快照 —— **设置卡的改动要等下次启动才生效**。
- 关掉某个工具时，它的 system prompt 指引段也一并消失：指引每次装配都按「那个 scope 真注册着哪些工具」现取，没装浏览器的机器少掉 render / capture_xhr 那几句，sidecar 没起来的机器一句都没有。指引段排在内置 `web_fetch` 指引旁边。
- `scrapling_crawl` 登记自己的作业类型，`job_list` 因此把它的作业标成爬虫而不是 shell 作业。

readme.section: 工具一览
readme.text:
| 工具 | 后端 | 需要浏览器 | 并发 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `scrapling_fetch` | `Fetcher`（curl_cffi） | 否 | 可并发；开了 `allowWriteMethods` 之后写动词转串行 |
| `scrapling_extract` | `Selector` + CSS/XPath + `adaptive` | 否 | 可并发 |
| `scrapling_locate` | 文本 / 正则 / 相似元素定位，返回生成的选择器 | 否 | 可并发 |
| `scrapling_links` | `LinkExtractor` 加下一页候选 | 否 | 可并发 |
| `scrapling_render` | `StealthySession`（patchright） | 是 | 串行；反检测开关（`solveCloudflare` / `hideCanvas` / `blockWebrtc`）也在这一条上 |
| `scrapling_capture_xhr` | 单页临时会话、页级记录 | 是 | 串行 |
| `scrapling_session_open` / `scrapling_session_fetch` / `scrapling_session_network` / `scrapling_session_state_save` / `scrapling_session_state_load` / `scrapling_session_list` / `scrapling_session_close` | Scrapling 会话类 | 仅浏览器会话 | 串行 |
| `scrapling_session_read` | 读浏览器会话当前页的 DOM | 是 | 串行 |
| `scrapling_session_act` | 会话页上的结构化动作（部署门禁） | 是 | 串行 |
| `scrapling_download` | 下载字节到 `dataDir/downloads`（部署门禁） | 否 | 可并发 |
| `scrapling_screenshot` | PNG/JPEG 截图交给 attachment 服务 | 是 | 串行 |
| `scrapling_crawl` | Scrapling Spider 框架（`content` / `sitemap` / `feed` / `shopify`），作为作业运行 | 否 | 串行 |
| `scrapling_answer` | 任一抓取路径 + `ctx.llm` | `render: true` 时是 | 串行 |

readme.section: 工具一览
readme.text:
- **配额。** 同开会话至多 8 个（其中浏览器会话 3 个，每个是一个真实的 Chromium 进程）、同时在跑的爬虫 2 个、单页正文按 `*MaxOutputChars` 封顶、单个协议帧 8 MB、待处理队列 16 帧。撞上限返回明确的错误码（`SESSION_LIMIT` / `CRAWL_BUSY` / `BAD_FRAME`），由模型自己退避。
- **`scrapling_crawl` 立刻返回作业 id** —— 一次爬取是分钟级的，而工具调用有超时。用 `job_list` 看进度、`job_output` 读结果、`job_kill` 中断；这一工具要求作业后端能 attach controller，没有的 profile 干脆不注册它（单页抓取不受影响）。爬虫另有总时长上限（`crawlMaxRuntimeSeconds`），且不会爬出起始域。礼貌性默认沿用 Scrapling spider 的默认值 —— **不遵守** robots.txt、每域延迟 0、最多 4 个请求并发 —— 它是部署决定，不是某次调用的参数（见[设置项](#设置项)）。
- **`scrapling_answer` 先抓页面，再带着问题交给模型**，直接拿结论而不是整页正文。默认跟随当前会话正在用的模型（读的是会话的活请求头，中途换模型也跟着变），不额外烧一份额度；要单独指定就用 `answerProvider` / `answerModel`。网页正文是**不可信输入** —— 提示把它显式框成数据，但这道防线是提示层面的：它降低风险，不等于消除风险。

readme.section: 渲染还是静态
readme.text:
`scrapling_render` 比 `scrapling_fetch` 慢得多、也更吃内存，所以默认从静态抓取起步。两条判据：

- **渲染结果比静态抓取短，就退回静态抓取。** 不少页面在服务端下发了可读文字，加载后又用自己的脚本把那些容器清空、换成 canvas / Lottie 动画 —— 对这类页面渲染后只会更少，任何等待设置都补不回来。这是站点行为，不是插件缺陷。
- **`waitSelector` 等的是「元素出现」，不是「内容稳定」。** 元素可能在匹配成功之后才被脚本移除，所以「选择器匹配上了」不代表那部分内容还在结果里。

还有一条不成判据但值得知道：SVG 里的坐标轴刻度**用哪个工具都抓不到** —— Markdown 转换不输出 `<svg>` / `<text>` 节点。真要图表数值，走 `scrapling_capture_xhr` 找背后的 JSON 接口。

readme.section: 替代内置的抓取与搜索
readme.text:
插件把自己注册成 `ctx.web` 的 **fetch provider** 与 **search provider**，于是内置的 `web_fetch` / `web_search` 实际由 Scrapling 执行，而不是 dsh 那套纯 HTTP 实现。模型调用的仍然是 `web_fetch` / `web_search` —— 工具名换不掉（同名注册会抛错），provider 接缝是官方留的替换通道。两个 provider 默认注册（`provideWebFetch` / `provideWebSearch`），但这本身顶不掉任何东西：

1. `provideWebFetch` / `provideWebSearch` 保持默认（`true`）；
2. 在**部署配置**里把 `fetchProvider` / `searchProvider` 设为 `"scrapling"`。

readme.section: 替代内置的抓取与搜索
readme.text: 配了 id 就以它为准，这就是第 2 步必须做的原因 —— 而两个 provider 都可用、又没点名时，`ctx.web` 会给 `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS`，对应工具直接不可用。把那一行指向本插件后，有两个反向风险：

readme.section: 替代内置的抓取与搜索
readme.text:
- **sidecar 起不来时，内置 `web_fetch` 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE`**，而不是悄悄退回纯 HTTP。
- **fetch provider 会真正执行输出预算**：正文超过 `fetchMaxOutputChars` 时按头尾窗口实际裁剪并标记 `truncated`，不是原样放行只打一个标记。失败保留 sidecar 的错误码前缀（`URL_BLOCKED`、`SIDECAR_TIMEOUT`、`SIDECAR_UNAVAILABLE`），策略拒绝、进程崩溃与超时可以区分。
- **日后卸掉插件却留着那一行**，内置工具报 `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_MISSING` —— 要回去把 `fetchProvider` / `searchProvider` 一并撤掉。

readme.section: 替代内置的抓取与搜索
readme.text: 搜索拆成两截，因为 Scrapling 自己不是搜索引擎：**检索**在 Python sidecar 里走 `searchBackend` 指定的后端 —— Tavily、Bing HTML、Brave（API）、Serper（API）、DuckDuckGo HTML 或 SearXNG（JSON API）；**读取**由本插件完成 —— 前 `searchRenderTopN` 条会真的抓下来并在有浏览器时渲染，一次 `web_search` 同时拿到「哪些页面相关」与「这些页面实际说了什么」。`auto` 有 `tavilyApiKey` 走 Tavily、配了 `searxngEndpoint` 走 SearXNG；两者都没有时，只有打开 `searchPublicFallback` 才会走公共引擎（Bing；显式选 `duckduckgo` 后端时才走 DuckDuckGo），否则 provider 不可用、`web_search` 报 `SEARCH_BACKEND_MISSING` 而不是把查询发出去。本机只对 Tavily 与 Bing 打过真实端点；Brave、Serper、DuckDuckGo 与 SearXNG 按各家文档形状实现、用本地 stub 验证，真实 key 与真实实例仍未验。返回的 URL 逐条过与抓取同一道闸门；单条页面读不到只跳过那一条，搜索结果里混着失效链接是常态。

readme.section: 替代内置的抓取与搜索
readme.text: 有一个后果需要知道：`dsh-web` 的抓取正文是 `html | text` 的**封闭**联合，没有 `markdown` 这一档，加一种 kind 是跨包的协同改动，不是插件能扩展的。所以 fetch provider 把 Scrapling 的 Markdown 输出报成 `text`，内置渲染路径显示完全正常。要 `html` 或 CSS 选择器时直接用 `scrapling_fetch`。

readme.section: MCP 模式
readme.text:
`integrationMode` 在三种互斥的工具面里选一种。它是部署配置（`cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config:` 块），插件装配时读一次，改完必须重启。

| 模式 | 注册什么 |
|---|---|
| `native`（默认） | 上面列出的 `scrapling_*` 工具 |
| `mcp` | 不注册原生工具；把同一份工具表端成 MCP server |
| `official-mcp` | 既不注册原生工具，也不起本插件的 server；`setup` 只生成官方 `scrapling-mcp` 的 `dsh-mcp-client` 条目 —— 它跑在自己的进程与会话里，**不经本插件的 URL 闸门** |

`mcp` 模式的 server 跑在插件自己的宿主进程里，调的还是同一个 sidecar，所以 URL 闸门、会话、作业与 adaptive 存储都是原生工具那一份 —— 不存在第二套实现可以漂移。

readme.section: MCP 模式
readme.text:
- **端点** `http://127.0.0.1:<mcpPort>/mcp`（`mcpPort`，默认 `39217`）。只绑回环；声明正文超过 1 MiB 的请求直接 `413`，其他路径 `404`。server 是无会话形态：每条请求各起一份协议对象，跨请求不留状态。
- **鉴权**默认关。设了环境变量 `DSH_SCRAPLING_MCP_TOKEN` 之后，每个请求都必须带 `Authorization: Bearer <token>`。这一枚只从环境读、绝不从 profile 读，所以它不会落进配置文件。
- **工具**就是 native 注册的那批 `ToolDefinition`：同一份 JSON Schema、同一套参数校验、同一个渲染器。`scrapling_answer` 不端出去 —— 它要走宿主会话的模型路由，外部客户端没有这一层。`search` 只在这面上有，因为 MCP 客户端没有 `ctx.web` 那个接缝。门禁一致：`allowBrowserActions=false` 时没有 `session_act`，`allowFileDownloads=false` 时没有 `download`，没有可用搜索后端时 `search` 也不出现。
- **结果**是文本内容；截图改为 MCP 的 image content，而不是宿主 attachment。工具失败回 `isError` 加可读消息，不会把连接掐断。
- **名字**：MCP 原始名是工具名去掉 `scrapling_` 前缀，dsh 的 MCP 客户端再显示成 `mcp__scrapling__<原始名>`。

| 原生工具 | MCP 原始名 |

| `scrapling_extract` | `extract` |
| `scrapling_locate` | `locate` |

readme.section: MCP 模式
readme.text:
要接进 dsh 需要 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`，本插件刻意不依赖它。装与当期宿主同一条线的版本 —— npm 的 `latest` 比宿主还旧，宿主对不匹配的对端是直接拒绝：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <名> add @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.2-rc.1

readme.section: 宿主在 0.2.1-rc.5 线时改用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.5
readme.text:
```

再往那个 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 加一条（没配 token 就不写 `headers`）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: scrapling-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: scrapling
        transport: streamable-http
        url: http://127.0.0.1:39217/mcp
        failOnStartupError: false
        # 只有设了 DSH_SCRAPLING_MCP_TOKEN 才加：
        # headers:
        #   Authorization: !!js '`Bearer ${process.env.DSH_SCRAPLING_MCP_TOKEN}`'
```

`mcpPort` 与那条 URL 必须同值；改过端口就要重新应用这一条。

readme.section: 宿主在 0.2.1-rc.5 线时改用 @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client@0.2.1-rc.5
readme.text: 这里的 `failOnStartupError` 刻意取 `false`：端口要等插件与 Python sidecar 握手完成才开始 listen，而客户端在**第一趟**连接失败（`Version negotiation probe failed: connect ECONNREFUSED`）时就把这条 fiber 抛掉，宿主报的是「1 entry did not activate」。它自带的重连默认是开的（500ms 起退避、上限 10 次），第一趟被拒本就该由重连吸收 —— 取 `true` 等于让 fiber 的启动顺序决定这一档能不能用。官方那条 `stdio` 相反，留 `true`：那里的 server 由客户端自己 spawn，连不上就是真坏了，要报得响亮。

readme.section: `setup --mode` 与 `doctor`
readme.text:
`setup --mode` 产出上面那段条目文本，它不改写任何 profile。不带 `--apply` 是 dry-run；带上就写到 `<dataDir>/mcp/<模式>.patch.yml` 并把路径打出来 —— 把它并进 `cordis.patch.yml` 仍是你的动作，因为宿主没有安全追加那个文件的接口（`dsh --dump-config` 会把 profile 根配置整个重写一遍）。

```sh
dsh-scrapling setup --mode mcp --port 45991 --with-auth --apply
dsh-scrapling setup --mode native --apply     # 写出的文件里一条条目都不留
dsh-scrapling doctor --mode mcp --profile <profileDir>
```

readme.section: `setup --mode` 与 `doctor`

readme.section: 代理
readme.text:
抓取从哪儿出去，按这个顺序判定，**先命中先算**：

1. `proxyBypass` 或环境里的 `NO_PROXY` 命中这个主机 → 直连。
2. 设置卡上的 `proxyUrl` 非空 → 用它。
3. 环境里的 `http_proxy` / `https_proxy` / `all_proxy`（大写同样认）→ 用对应那一栏。
4. 操作系统的代理设置（macOS 的 `scutil --proxy`、Windows 的 Internet Settings）→ 用它。
5. 都没有 → 直连。

各环境下的实际表现 —— **开或不开代理，工具都直接可用，一行设置都不用填**：

readme.section: 代理
readme.text:
| 你的环境 | 静态抓取 | 渲染 / XHR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 不开代理 | 直连 | 直连 |
| TUN 模式（系统层接管） | 直连，由 TUN 转发 | 同左 |
| 只在 shell 里 export `HTTPS_PROXY` | 自动跟随 | 自动跟随 |
| macOS / Windows「系统代理」开关 | **自动跟随** | 自动跟随 |
| 内网站点 / 内网 Git | 用 `proxyBypass` 排除 | 用 `proxyBypass` 排除 |
| PAC（自动配置脚本） | 不跟随，stderr 会提示填 `proxyUrl` | 浏览器原生跟随 |

几条容易踩的细节：

readme.section: 代理
readme.text:
- **解析出来的代理会显式交给浏览器引擎。** Chromium 不读 `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY`，只在 shell 里 export 过的代理会盖住静态抓取却盖不住浏览器 —— 本包把解析出的代理随每次浏览器抓取传进去，补上这个缺口。**浏览器会话**的代理仍在 `scrapling_session_open` 时定一次：中途换要新建浏览器 context，而新建等于丢掉会话攒下的 cookie 与登录态 —— 那恰恰是会话存在的理由。静态会话每个请求各自判一次。
- **PAC 是唯一还要手工填 `proxyUrl` 的形态。** 求值 PAC 要下载脚本并跑 JavaScript，各平台格式互不相同，本包不猜；静态抓取在 stderr 指明，浏览器则经自己的系统设置原生跟随。
- **代理与合成 DNS 是两件事。** fake-IP 模式的代理把**每个**域名都解析进 `198.18.0.0/15`（TUN 客户端常落在 `100.64.0.0/10`），两段都不是公网 unicast，闸门会把每个 URL 都判成私网 —— 开了代理反而全都抓不了。闸门**自动识别**这一类解析器（三个与用户目标无关的控制域名全部落在同一段非公网段里），随后放宽到已知合成池的**整段**。控制域名只用来触发判定，不用来推断池的大小 —— 三个按名字哈希的答案不含任何大小信息。私网、回环、链路本地都不在池子里，内网与元数据地址在开着代理的机器上照旧被拒。`syntheticDnsRanges` 是自建池落在两段之外时的手动兜底；识别不出来时**维持最严**。
- **走了代理时，本机解析不出来的主机名不再判否。** 域名由代理解析，而在 DNS 被按地区过滤的网络里，恰恰是这些站点才需要代理。IP 字面量、本地能解析出来的私网答案、单标签主机名（`intranet`、`router`）照旧拒。
- **走代理时关掉 WebRTC 泄露。** Chromium 的 WebRTC 能绕过 HTTP/SOCKS 代理直接发 UDP，页面里一句 STUN 就能问出访客的真实出口 IP；有代理在就把 `blockWebrtc` 钉成真，不看模型入参。
- **凭据不会出现在任何日志或能力协商帧里。** 上报只回显 `scheme://host:port`，并用 `source` 标出代理来自 `settings` / `environment` / `system` / `none` 哪一档 —— 用户报「抓不到东西」时，这一栏就是第一眼的答案。填错的代理地址记一行 stderr 并按「未配置」处理，而不是让插件加载失败。

readme.section: 安全说明
readme.text:
- **SSRF。** Scrapling 自身没有任何 SSRF 防护。本包在 Host 侧加一层 URL 策略 —— scheme 白名单、拒绝 URL 内嵌凭据、长度上限、authority 里有反斜杠或控制字符即拒、DNS 解析后按**整个答案集**判定是否全为公网、IPv4-mapped 与 NAT64 地址按内嵌 IPv4 重判 —— 并在 Python 侧把 scheme、内嵌凭据与地址这三条再强制一次（长度上限留在 Host 侧策略里，因为它是一项部署设置）。发出请求的路径只认 `http`/`https`，内嵌凭据一律判拒；`ws`/`wss` 只在 WebSocket 握手那一处按地址判。**判的和发出去的是同一个地址**：闸门判的是 WHATWG 归一后的结果，sidecar 转发的也是这个归一串，否则「判的是 A、连的是 B」本身就会成为绕过面。Host 侧那道策略由 `SidecarClient.call` 统一执行，而它把模型交进来**要拿去取回内容**的每一处 URL 都筛一遍 —— `url`，加上 crawl 的 `sitemapUrl` 与 `feedUrl` —— 只留一处刻意的例外：三个离线解析器（`scrapling_extract`、`scrapling_locate`、`scrapling_links`）的 `url` 只作相对地址的解析基准，不会拿它向任何地方发请求，因此 `lib/sidecar.ts` 的 `BASE_ONLY_METHODS` 不放它过闸 —— 除此之外覆盖每一个工具与 `web_fetch` provider，判否时抛 `URL_BLOCKED`、请求根本不会写进管道；`web_search` provider 对它准备交回的 URL 跑同一道闸门，被拒的命中不会成为可引用的 source。浏览器侧的守卫覆盖主导航、子资源、XHR 与 WebSocket 握手。
- 已知缺口，写在明处：
  - **连接钉扎**（undici 层技术）对非 Node 传输不可用；校验与真正建连之间有 TOCTOU 窗口。静态抓取由 curl_cffi 的 `follow_redirects="safe"` 兜住重定向，浏览器抓取由 Python 侧的 route handler 兜住。
  - **NAT64 前缀不做动态探测。** 两个标准化前缀已覆盖；运营商自建的要用 `nat64Prefixes` 声明，否则藏在 IPv6 里的私网 IPv4 会被当成普通公网 IPv6 放行。
  - **没有端口白名单**（默认不限端口），与 dsh 内置 fetch provider 的取舍一致。
  - **爬虫每页收进结果前复判两次** —— 一次过守卫（最终 URL 仍可能落在私网上），一次过起始域，因

readme.section: 已知边界
readme.text:
- **对「服务端下发可读文字、加载后自己换掉」的页面，渲染只会丢内容。** 这类站点把文字给搜索引擎与无 JS 用户，加载后清空容器换成 canvas / Lottie 动画，渲染后拿到的更少 —— 见[渲染还是静态](#渲染还是静态)。
- **SVG 里的坐标轴刻度用哪个工具都拿不到**：Markdown 转换不输出 `<svg>` / `<text>` 节点。要图表数值，用 `scrapling_capture_xhr` 找 JSON 接口。
- **浏览器会话的代理在 `session_open` 时定一次**，会话内 `proxyBypass` 不逐 URL 生效（换 context 会丢掉会话存在的理由 —— cookie 与登录态）。静态会话每个请求各自判一次。
- **`scrapling_session_fetch` 的 `headers` 与 `retries` 只属于 static 会话。** 上游对浏览器会话静默丢掉这两个键，本包替它报错（`BAD_ARGS` 并点名该改用哪个旋钮）——「拧了没反应」正是这条边界要消灭的故障形态。
- **浏览器身份类的旋钮只开在真能用上它的工具上。** `useragent` / `locale` / `timezoneId` / `headless` 摆在一次性的浏览器工具与 `scrapling_session_open` 上 —— 它们只在会话构造期生效，会话内传过去会被上游静默丢掉。
- **网络历史是会话级的。** 记录是构造期设置（部署默认 `recordRequests`，或每次 `scrapling_session_open` 上的 `recordNetwork`）；没开记录的会话报错，而不是回一个空列表。
- **`scrapling_screenshot` 绕过文本清洗。** 截图拍的是页面在视口里真正渲染出来的东西 —— 包括 token、私信、登录后才可见的数据等从未出现在 DOM 文本里的视觉秘密。截图经宿主 attachment 服务落库，只有该服务挂载时才注册。 交回的是该服务**归一化之后**的引用：声明为 PNG 的字节可能被存成 `image/jpeg` 且尺寸更小，而 `originalDimensions` 记的是页面真正产出的那一份（宿主契约：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment` 的 `saveImage`）。`scrapling_download` 把字节写进 `dataDir/downloads`，绝不覆盖已有文件，`filename` 里带路径成分会被拒绝。
- **`scrapling_extract`、`scrapling_locate` 与 `scrapling_links` 是离线解析器。** 三者只读调用方给的 HTM

readme.section: 常见问题
readme.text:
| 问题 | 回答 |
| --- | --- |
| 模型说 render / capture_xhr 工具不存在 | 这台机器没有浏览器引擎 —— 插件只注册能用的。跑 `python -m patchright install chromium` 再重启。如果**所有**工具都不在，是 sidecar 没起来：启动日志点名选中的解释器，缺 Scrapling 的报错里带着可照抄的 pip 命令 |
| 开了代理之后所有抓取都被拦 | fake-IP 代理把每个域名都解析进非公网段；闸门会自动识别这一类并放宽到已知池。自建池落在两段之外的，填进 `syntheticDnsRanges`。私网与回环地址被拦是故意的 |
| `web_fetch` 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_CONFIGURED_UNAVAILABLE` / `_MISSING` | 部署那一行指向了本插件：要么 sidecar 没起来（解释器或 Scrapling —— 看启动日志），要么插件已卸载而 `fetchProvider` / `searchProvider` 那一行还在。把那一行也撤掉 |

readme.section: 开发
readme.text:
```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run check     # 类型检查 → lint → client 构建 → host 构建 → 测试 → 格式，随后是 Python 链
pnpm run test:py   # Python sidecar 的端到端验证
```

readme.section: 开发
readme.text:
- **Python 这一侧与 TypeScript 同等待遇。** `check` 以 `check:py` 收尾：解释器播报、面清点（随包发布的 `.py` 与测试目录必须都在 —— 测试目录缺失时「干净」与「没测过」不可分辨）、依赖一致性检查、ruff check、ruff format、mypy、sidecar 端到端、bandit（全部 severity；误报才用带理由的 `# nosec`）、以及**只量随包发布模块**的覆盖率地板。开发工具装法：往 `test:py` 用的那个解释器里 `pip install -r py/requirements-dev.txt`。
- **Python 3.14 地板写在四处、说的是同一件事：** 两份 README、ruff 与 mypy 的 target、以及 `py/bridge.py` 的运行时硬闸 —— 在任何 Scrapling import 之前退出且 stdout 零字节（stdout 是协议帧，旧解释器看到的是退出码加一行 stderr，而不是乱码）。
- **mypy 会查未注解函数体，并拒绝未注解 def 与失效 ignore。** Playwright 的 `page` / `route` / `websocket` 运行前没有形状，所以 `ignore_missing_imports` 与 `ANN401` 保持关闭；开启的是这三项，不是完整 `strict` 档。
- 源码全部是 TypeScript。`host.js` 与 `client.js` 是**构建产物**且故意用 `.js`：Node 拒绝为 `node_modules` 里的包剥类型，而 dsh 正是从那里加载本插件的。产物是 ESM-only，`require()` 拿不到它，这是有意的。
- 钉住发布形态的门：`test/publish-manifest.test.ts`（入口目标都在 `files` 覆盖内、源码不作入口、`dsh-*` 一律精确钉且同版本、没有内联的宿主包正文、注释与文档里没有日期与坏字节）与 `test/readme-parity.test.ts`（两份 README 都写全每个工具与每枚设置卡旋钮，章节结构一致）。
- 发布走 [`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](./.github/workflows/publish.yml)（手动触发，OIDC trusted publishing + `--provenance`）。
